ideas.title: Following the Money: Trump Administration's Use of Federal Funds
ideas.description: Investigate the Trump administration's use of federal funds and determine if there are any patterns of using funds for political purposes.
questions: What other instances of using federal funds for political purposes have occurred?
How much money has been allocated for these purposes?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal a pattern of using federal funds as a means of exerting political pressure on states. By following the money, we can determine the extent of this practice and its impact on the country.
